## Change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. State any changed API, ranking, data or deployment behavior.

## Verification

Link the checks run on this revision and describe the observed result. Include browser evidence for UI changes. For ranking changes, link fresh provider evaluation with human-judged n and baseline comparison; `not_evaluated` is not a passing ranking gate.

## Deployment and evidence

State local-only, awaiting deployment, or deployed with the observed Argo revision, workload image/health and served version. Link real provider findings only when they exist. Describe remaining limitations and rollback when relevant.
